entries.name: Light World sprites
entries.description: Four shared OBJ rows (1-4). Actor rows below apply only to the stated context; changing a color affects other users of that row.
entries.provenance: Native Palettes_Load_SpriteMain $1B:EC9E selects world with $8A bit $40; Yaze global_sprites[0], PC $0DD218. Oracle source e0748350; Yaze palette_constants.h at 9aa6b639; source review 2026-10-16.

usages.name: Impa follower
usages.context: Follower $01, Light World. Primary art sheet; the follower loader also stages shared sheet $65.
usages.source: Native LoadFollowerGraphics $00:D423 selects $64 for follower $01; Follower_Draw.palette $09:A8FA selects OBJ4. Oracle Sprites/NPCs/impa.asm documents the Zelda replacement. Pixel source: Data/graphics/spr64.png via Data/graphics/source_sprite_sheets.json (sprite $64 / Yaze gfx $D7); the current identity override requires the original base-ROM pixels.

usages.name: Zora Baby follower
usages.context: Follower $09, Light World. Primary art sheet; the follower loader also stages shared sheet $65.
usages.source: Native LoadFollowerGraphics $00:D43A selects $59 for followers $09-$0B. Oracle Sprites/NPCs/followers.asm org $09A902 overrides the follower palette to $02. Art source: base ROM sprite sheet $59.

entries.name: Dark World sprites
entries.description: Four shared OBJ rows (1-4), selected by world state. Light World actor bindings are not automatically valid here.
entries.provenance: Native Palettes_Load_SpriteMain $1B:ECA2-$1B:ECB2 selects the alternate bank with $8A bit $40; Yaze global_sprites[1], PC $0DD290. Oracle source e0748350; Yaze palette_constants.h at 9aa6b639; source review 2026-10-16.

entries.name: Actor half-row 03
entries.description: Seven colors for OBJ5 or OBJ6, selected by context. The disassembly names aux1 and aux2 both refer to this Yaze group; this is not sprites_aux1.
entries.provenance: Native Palettes_Load_SpriteAux1 $1B:ECC5 reads $0AAD; Palettes_Load_SpriteAux2 $1B:ECE4 reads $0AAE. Both use PaletteData_spriteaux_00 at PC $0DD4E0 + index * 14. Yaze room.cc BuildDungeonSpriteRenderPalette maps paletteset bytes 2 and 3 to sprites_aux3. Oracle source e0748350; Yaze palette_constants.h at 9aa6b639; source review 2026-10-16.

entries.name: Actor half-row 05
entries.description: Seven colors for OBJ5 or OBJ6. This entry names the data bank; the room or area chooses its actual use.
entries.provenance: Native Palettes_Load_SpriteAux1 $1B:ECC5 and Palettes_Load_SpriteAux2 $1B:ECE4; Yaze sprites_aux3[5], PC $0DD4E0 + 5 * 14. Oracle source e0748350; Yaze palette_constants.h at 9aa6b639; source review 2026-10-16.

entries.name: Link green mail
entries.description: Link OBJ7 colors for green mail. Transformations and effects can replace colors at runtime.
entries.provenance: Yaze PaletteMetadata::kArmor, PC $0DD308; native Link armor palette loader. Oracle Masks/mask_routines.asm Palette_ArmorAndGloves and mask form routines can replace OBJ7. Oracle source e0748350; Yaze palette_constants.h at 9aa6b639; source review 2026-10-16.

entries.name: Underworld main 00
entries.description: The first underworld main palette set. The room paletteset selects its use; no dungeon-name binding is inferred.
entries.provenance: Yaze PaletteMetadata::kDungeonMain, PC $0DD734, 90 colors per set; Oracle Core/tables.asm UnderworldPaletteSets. Oracle source e0748350; Yaze palette_constants.h at 9aa6b639; source review 2026-10-16.

entries.name: HUD main
entries.description: The main HUD palette. Some colors are supplied by ASM: Menu/menu_palette.asm writes $1BD662 and $1BD66A. Other colors remain in the edit ROM.
entries.provenance: Yaze PaletteMetadata::kHud, PC $0DD660; Oracle Menu/menu_palette.asm org $1BD662 and org $1BD66A. Oracle source e0748350; Yaze palette_constants.h at 9aa6b639; source review 2026-10-16.

entries.name: Dark World map
entries.description: All 128 map colors are replaced from dw_palette.bin during the build. This is source metadata; it does not grant a write permission or replace the hack manifest.
entries.provenance: Yaze PaletteMetadata::kOverworldMiniMap, PC $055C27; Oracle Overworld/world_map.asm org $0ADC27 and incbin dw_palette.bin. Oracle source e0748350; Yaze palette_constants.h at 9aa6b639; source review 2026-10-16.
